# Online Cyber Tools — MCP tool catalogue

Auto-generated by `php bin/console mcp:tools-doc` in the source repo —
**do not edit by hand.** Lists every tool this MCP server exposes
(enabled in the site menu, `mcp_compatible != 'none'`), grouped by category.

**279 tools** in **15 categories.**

- Browse live: <https://onlinecybertools.com/#browse-the-full-inventory>
- Machine-readable spec: <https://onlinecybertools.com/api/openapi.json>
- Pick a subset / build a config: <https://onlinecybertools.com/integrations/mcp-plugin-builder>

Restrict the exposed surface with `OCTOOLS_TOOLS` using the **id** column
(e.g. `OCTOOLS_TOOLS=base64_encode,sha256`).
